content: Penicillin G sodium for Injection, USP, is a sterile powder form of penicillin G sodium that requires reconstitution prior to use. It is classified as an antibacterial agent and is specifically designed for administration either intravenously or intramuscularly. Chemically, it is the monosodium salt of 3,3-dimethyl-7-oxo-6-(2-phenylacetamido)-4-thia-1-azabicyclo[3.2.0]heptane-2-carboxylic acid. Its structural formula corresponds to that of benzylpenicillin sodium, which is a water-soluble compound. Physically, penicillin G sodium appears as a white to nearly white crystalline powder that is almost odorless. Upon reconstitution, it forms a clear, colorless solution. Each million units of penicillin G sodium contains approximately 5.68 milliequivalents (mEq) of sodium.
